extraTests.domain: All ordered chapter arrays n=1..4, ci=1..3, x=1..4; enumerate every subject permutation (480 inputs).

39518384.reason: When x<n it neither sorts chapters nor clamps the multiplier to 1, eventually using zero/negative effort.

41611565.reason: Sorts chapter counts as decimal strings, not integers; differing digit lengths assign incorrect descending multipliers.

43505696.reason: Prints only inside the x<=1 branch. When all subjects finish with x>1 it exits without printing the correctly accumulated result; empty output is not algorithmic wrongness.

51605934.reason: Initializes time with a[0] instead of x*a[0], and additionally adds a[i] after weighting later subjects; the effort total is wrong.

51892624.reason: Bubble sort is quadratic but the subsequent sorted/clamped effort calculation is correct; counted failure is TLE only.
